# Canvas Game Idea

**Pixel Runner** – A side‑scrolling endless runner on an HTML canvas. The player controls a pixel character that auto‑runs forward; clicking/tapping makes it jump to avoid randomly generated obstacles (spikes, gaps, enemies). The game gradually accelerates. **Lose condition:** colliding with an obstacle or falling off the screen. Score is measured by distance survived.

1: // Pixel Runner – simple endless runner for a canvas with id "game"
2: // The script creates a side‑scrolling runner that jumps on click/tap.
3: 
4: (function () {
5:   // Get canvas and context
6:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
7:   if (!canvas) {
8:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
9:     return;
10:   }
11:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
12:   // Load sounds (using placeholder URLs)
13:   const jumpSound = new Audio('https://actions.googleusercontent.com/actions/media/largest_id/1581833630'); // placeholder jump sound
14:   const gameOverSound = new Audio('https://actions.googleusercontent.com/actions/media/largest_id/1581833631'); // placeholder game over sound
15: 
16:   // Set fixed size (can be changed later)
17:   canvas.width = 800;
18:   canvas.height = 200;
19: 
20:   // Game constants
21:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
22:   const JUMP_VELOCITY = -12;
23:   const PLAYER_SIZE = 20;
24:   const OBSTACLE_WIDTH = 20;
25:   const OBSTACLE_GAP = 150; // min distance between obstacles
26:   const SPEED_START = 3;
27:   const SPEED_INCREMENT = 0.001; // per frame
28: 
29:   // State
30:   let speed = SPEED_START;
31:   let score = 0;
32:   let frameCount = 0;
33:   const player = {
34:     x: 50,
35:     y: canvas.height - PLAYER_SIZE,
36:     vy: 0,
37:     width: PLAYER_SIZE,
38:     height: PLAYER_SIZE,
39:     onGround: true,
40:   };
41:   const obstacles = [];
42:   const clouds = []; // background clouds
43: 
44:   // Input – jump on any click/tap
45:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', jump);
46:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', jump);
47: function jump(e) {
48:     e.preventDefault();
49:     if (player.onGround) {
50:       player.vy = JUMP_VELOCITY;
51:       player.onGround = false;
52:       // Play jump sound
53:       if (jumpSound) {
54:         jumpSound.currentTime = 0;
55:         jumpSound.play();
56:       }
57:     }
58:   }
59:   }
60: 
61:   // Helper – spawn new obstacle
62:   function spawnObstacle() {
63: 
64: 
65:   // Helper – spawn background cloud
66:   function spawnCloud() {
67:     const radius = Math.random() * 20 + 15;
68:     const y = Math.random() * (canvas.height * 0.4);
69:     clouds.push({
70:       x: canvas.width,
71:       y: y,
72:       radius: radius,
73:       speedFactor: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2, // slower than obstacles
74:     });
75:   }
76: 
77: 
78:   // Collision detection (AABB)
79:   function collides(a, b) {
80:     return a.x < b.x + b.width &&
81:            a.x + a.width > b.x &&
82:            a.y < b.y + b.height &&
83:            a.y + a.height > b.y;
84:   }
85: 
86:   // Main loop
87:   function update() {
88:     // Clear and draw background gradient
89:     const bgGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
90:     bgGradient.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB'); // sky
91:     bgGradient.addColorStop(1, '#fff');   // horizon
92:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGradient;
93:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
94:     // ground line
95:     ctx.fillStyle = '#654321';
96:     ctx.fillRect(0, canvas.height - 5, canvas.width, 5);
97: 
98:     // Update player physics
99:     // Draw clouds (parallax background)
100:     // spawn clouds occasionally
101:     if (frameCount % 200 === 0) {
102:         spawnCloud();
103:     }
104:     // update and draw clouds
105:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
106:     for (let i = clouds.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
107:         const c = clouds[i];
108:         c.x -= speed * c.speedFactor;
109:         ctx.beginPath();
110:         ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, c.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
111:         ctx.fill();
112:         if (c.x + c.radius < 0) {
113:             clouds.splice(i, 1);
114:         }
115:     }
116: 
117:     // Update player physics
118:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
119:     player.y += player.vy;
120:     if (player.y + player.height >= canvas.height) {
121:       player.y = canvas.height - player.height;
122:       player.vy = 0;
123:       player.onGround = true;
124:     }
125: 
126:     // Draw player – orange circle with shadow
127:     ctx.save();
128:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6600';
129:     ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
130:     ctx.shadowBlur = 5;
131:     ctx.beginPath();
132:     ctx.arc(player.x + player.width/2, player.y + player.height/2, player.width/2, 0, Math.PI*2);
133:     ctx.fill();
134:     ctx.restore();
135: 
136:     // Spawn obstacles periodically
137:     if (frameCount % Math.round(120 / speed) === 0) {
138:       // Ensure enough gap from last obstacle
139:       if (obstacles.length === 0 || canvas.width - obstacles[obstacles.length - 1].x > OBSTACLE_GAP) {
140:         spawnObstacle();
141:       }
142:     }
143: 
144:     // Update and draw obstacles
145:     ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
146:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
147:       const obs = obstacles[i];
148:       obs.x -= speed;
149:       ctx.fillRect(obs.x, obs.y, obs.width, obs.height);
150: 
151:       // Collision check
152:       if (collides(player, obs)) {
153:         // Game over – stop animation and show score
154:       cancelAnimationFrame(animationId);
155:       // Play game over sound
156:       if (gameOverSound) {
157:         gameOverSound.currentTime = 0;
158:         gameOverSound.play();
159:       }
160:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
161:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
162:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
163:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
164:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
165:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
166:       ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 20);
167:       return;
168:       }
169: 
170:       // Remove off‑screen obstacles
171:       if (obs.x + obs.width < 0) {
172:         obstacles.splice(i, 1);
173:       }
174:     }
175: 
176:     // Update speed and score
177:     speed += SPEED_INCREMENT;
178:     score += speed;
179: 
180:     // Draw score
181:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
182:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
183:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
184:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 20);
185: 
186:     frameCount++;
187:     animationId = requestAnimationFrame(update);
188:   }
189: 
190:   let animationId = requestAnimationFrame(update);
191: })();
